title: Journey map (Isra and Mi'raj)
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y4 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: journey map (Isra and Mi'raj))
intro: Lesson 19: The Night Journey and Ascent: the gift of salah. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: The Ascent
points: Allah gave the command of salah

timeline.label: Reward
timeline.text: Five prayers with the reward of fifty

frame.label: Isra: Makkah to Jerusalem. One fact:
Mi'raj: upwards through the heavens. One fact:

keywords.def: the Night Journey from Makkah to Jerusalem

questions.q: Explain the difference between the Isra and the Mi'raj.
questions.a: Isra: the night journey from Makkah to Jerusalem. Mi'raj: the ascent through the heavens.

questions.q: How many prayers were first commanded?
Which surah begins with the Night Journey?
Make a two-part journey map on the pupil PDF: Makkah to Jerusalem (Isra), then upwards (Mi'raj), with one fact on each stage and a sentence: 'Salah is a gift because ...'
questions.a: Correct stages and facts; salah is a gift because it is our direct link with Allah, given in the heavens

questions.q: Extend: why do you think it happened after the Year of Sorrow?
questions.a: To comfort and honour the Prophet ﷺ after great sadness.

questions.q: Stretch: what does 'five prayers, the reward of fifty' tell us about Allah?

questions.a: A) Masjid al-Aqsa in Jerusalem. Al-Isra 17:1: from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa.

questions.q: Think again: what did Allah give, and why?
questions.a: The Isra and Mi'raj and salah: comfort and honour after hardship.
